scope: inherit metric_v2 Stage A1 exactly and require all four primary point estimates to beat the frozen baseline envelope at confirmation

non_retroactivity.rule: v3 must not relabel any prior run and applies only to candidates trained after this file is frozen

stage_a1_development_selection.ranking: maximum age-sex Harrell macro delta C among fully eligible epochs; delta-C ties within 0.001 use lower strict MAE

stage_a2_single_candidate_confirmation.candidate_input: exactly one hash-frozen Stage A1 winner

age_point_superiority_gates.comparator_policy: use the strongest of all six frozen baselines separately for each metric
age_point_superiority_gates.claim_rule: without favorable paired intervals, state only that all three age point estimates were higher

fivefold_aggregation.cell_metric: base Uno C, augmented Uno C, and augmented-minus-base gain
fivefold_aggregation.order: equal mean across five folds within organ, then equal mean across seven organs

paired_bootstrap.unit: participant cluster carrying all seven organ rows and all methods

inference.all_four_statistically_superior_claim: allowed only when the four favorable-direction paired intervals all exclude zero under a prespecified intersection-union test

key_secondary: IPCW Brier score at 60 months and IBS from 0 to 60 months
raw and calibration-only-recalibrated calibration curve, slope, calibration-in-the-large, and observed-to-expected ratio
IPCW decision-curve net benefit over prespecified threshold ranges with simultaneous bootstrap bands
required_diagnostics: proportional-hazards diagnostics and prespecified time-window effects
death competing-risk analysis using Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence with cause-specific and Fine-Gray sensitivity where appropriate
required_reviewer_confirmation.implementation_gate: Stage A2 cannot be declared complete until validation-only survival recalibration and calibration slope, IPCW DCA, PH diagnostics, and competing-risk implementations pass tests

supervision_fairness.claim_limit: age-only baselines do not isolate architecture because EHR-AGE also receives incident supervision
